book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: APOCALIPSIS I tsictesʌbal Jesucristo tsa' bʌ pʌsbenti Juan

content: Jini ángel am bʌ alʌ jun ti' c'ʌb
Tsaj q'uele tsa' loq'ui ti panchan yambʌ p'ʌtʌl bʌ ángel. Tsa' jubi tilel. An tocal ti' joytʌlel. An t'ox ja' ti' chañelal i jol. Che' yilal i wut bajche' q'uin. Che'ʌch i yoc bajche' wa'al bʌ c'ajc.
Ya' ti' c'ʌb an alʌ jun yujil bʌ bʌjlel. Jambil. Tsi' yʌc'ʌ ñoj bʌ i yoc ti' pam colem ñajb. Tsi' yʌc'ʌ ts'ej bʌ i yoc ti' pam lum.
Wen c'am tsi' cha'le oñel che' bajche' mi' cha'len t'an colem bajlum. Che' bʌ tsa' ujti ti oñel, wucyajl tsi' cha'le t'an chajc.

Che' wucyajl tsa' ujti ti t'an chajc tsa' cʌlʌ cajel ti ts'ijb. Tsa cubi t'an loq'uem bʌ ti panchan. Tsi' subeyon: Ñup'u ti sello chuqui tsi' subu che' wucyajl tsi' cha'le t'an chajc. Mach a ts'ijban, che'en.
Jini ángel tsa' bʌ j q'uele, jini xat wa'al bʌ ti colem ñajb yic'ot ti lum, tsi' letsa i c'ʌb ti panchan.

Tsi' subu t'an ti' c'aba' jini cuxul bʌ ti pejtelel ora, tsa' bʌ i mele panchan yic'ot i bʌl, yic'ot pañimil yic'ot i bʌl, yic'ot colem ñajb yic'ot i bʌl. Tsi' yʌlʌ mach chʌn jalix mi caj i jilel pañimil.

Che' mi' cha'len t'an i wucticlel ángel, che' mi' cajel i wus trompeta, mi' caj ti ts'ʌctiyel i sujmlel Dios maxto bʌ tsictiyemic ti yambʌ ora che' bajche' Dios tsi' sube i winicob, jini x'alt'añob, che'en.
Jini t'an tsa' bʌ cubi loq'uem bʌ ti panchan tsi' cha' pejcayon. Tsi' yʌlʌ: Cucu. Ch'ʌmʌ jini jamʌl bʌ jun am bʌ ti' c'ʌb jini ángel xat wa'al bʌ ti' pam colem ñajb yic'ot ti' pam lum, che'en.

Jini cha'an tsa' majliyon ya' ba'an jini ángel. Tsac sube yom mi' yʌq'ueñon jini alʌ jun. Jini ángel tsi' subeyon: Ch'ʌmʌ, c'uxu. Ch'aj mi caj a wubin ti a ñʌc'. Pero tsaj mi caj a wubin ti a wej lajal bajche' i tsajel chab, che'en.
Tsac ch'ʌmʌ jini alʌ jun am bʌ ti' c'ʌb ángel. Tsaj c'uxu. Tsa cubi ti quej tsaj che' bajche' chab. Che' bʌ tsa' ujti j c'ux, ch'aj tsa cubi tic ñʌc'.
Tsi' subeyon: Wersa ma' cha' sub chuqui mi caj i tajob cabʌl winicob x'ixicob yic'ot i reyob cabʌl tejclum tac, yujilo' bʌ cabʌl t'an ti chajp ti chajp, che'en.
